synopsis: Adrammelech appears in Athroza Quicksands and the Esper fight begins to Esper Battle (track 71). Authored text (its one entry, in Japanese in the us tree, asks "Again?" (Again / Stop)): もう一度？ (choices: もう一度 / やめる)
plays_when: in Athroza Quicksands (Zertinan Caverns), the first time the party walks into one of the areas that start the fight (set at ztc_d01 lines 816, 1111, 1406 and 1701) while Adrammelech is undefeated (the battle byte, global byte 0xA25, is 1 from the new game, pre_z0000 line 286, until the win): Adrammelech appears and the battle begins. The script reads and starts it on arrival (ztc_d01 lines 691 and 695, under the tests at lines 519 and 521: the entry-scene byte of slot 2 at global byte 0xCE8 is 0), it holds (ztc_d0100 line 32) until an area's touch releases it (ztc_d01 lines 915, 1210, 1505 and 1800), and the touch sets that byte to 1 (ztc_d01 lines 912, 1207, 1502 and 1797), so a later arrival goes straight to the fight. The map's replay menu, which reads it again, is never reached: the script jumps past it on entry (ztc_d01 line 463) and only the menu's own choices jump back into it (ztc_d01 lines 486 and 497).

plays_when: in Athroza Quicksands (Zertinan Caverns), when Adrammelech is defeated: the script starts it on arrival, with the entry scene the first time (ztc_d01 lines 693 and 696) and alone on a later arrival (lines 527 and 529, under the test at line 521), and it holds (ztc_d0101 line 40) until the script releases it after the win (ztc_d01 lines 615, 1001, 1296, 1591 and 1886); the win sets the battle byte (global byte 0xA25) to 2 (ztc_d01 lines 679, 1065, 1360, 1655 and 1950), so in story play it plays once (the developer menus also store 1 there, at evt_t0505 lines 10585, 10618, 10651 and 10684 and bin/evctrl line 1117). The map's replay menu, which reads it again, is never reached: the script jumps past it on entry (ztc_d01 line 463) and only the menu's own choices jump back into it (ztc_d01 lines 486 and 497).
